visualReview.method: Manual inspection of the full PNG and 512-pixel JPEG
visualReview.mark: Small worn ochre embers rising beneath a charcoal arch on vacant upper rock
visualReview.hands: Inherited Pepe retains two five-digit hands; no new hand or stencil was added
visualReview.ancestors: Pepe, older marks, rock, cracks, torchlight and framing remain; no pixel outside the new mark rectangle changed
visualReview.prohibitedContent: No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, real people or political or hateful symbols observed
visualReview.limits: Inherited rock has photographic-looking depth, retained as required; local visual review is not independent artistic certification
